current_date: August 2024 (cover); council page says the list took effect on 29 August 2024
current_evidence: The council's planning-validation-checklist page links this same PDF as the current checklist, which took effect on 29 August 2024. A draft 2026 replacement (draft-planning-application-validation-checklist-2026.pdf) went to consultation from 5 to 23 October 2026 but has not yet been adopted.

issues.detail: The List date of 2024-09-01 comes from the upload month in the URL path. The document cover says August 2024, and the council page says the list took effect on 29 August 2024.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'August 2024'. Planning validation checklist page: current local list took effect 29 August 2024.

issues.detail: A replacement list is pending, and the workbook does not mention it. A draft 2026 validation checklist (86 pages) was consulted on in October 2026. Once adopted it will supersede the August 2024 list, so this row should be flagged for review.
issues.evidence: Draft consultation page: 'This consultation closed on 23 October 2026'; https://haringey.gov.uk/sites/default/files/2026-10/draft-planning-application-validation-checklist-2026.pdf

issues.detail: Contaminated Land Assessment is the only requirement Grokbot lists under Householder, but the source expressly excludes householder applications. Grokbot's own excerpt says so.
issues.evidence: Contaminated Land Assessment, Types of Application: 'All applications excluding householder'

issues.detail: Several items that apply to householder applications are missing from the Householder rows. Basement Impact Assessment: all applications proposing new basement development. Flood risk assessment: all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3, and the list defines minor development to include householder. Arboricultural Impact Assessment: any development proposing tree works or affecting trees on or adjacent to the site. Biodiversity survey and report: all applications on designated biodiversity sites, or where protected species are known or likely. Heritage statement: works affecting listed or locally listed buildings, since only householder applications in Conservation Areas are excluded. Also missing are site photographs with a signed statement (all applications), block plan (all) and CIL form (more than 100 sqm GIA or a new dwelling).
issues.evidence: BIA: 'All applications proposing, new basement development'; Heritage statement: 'Excluding Householder applications in Conservation Areas'; AIA: 'Any development proposing tree works'

issues.detail: Several local requirements that apply to minor and all-scale applications were not captured. Accessibility statement: all applications creating new residential units, including conversions and change of use, to show M4(2) compliance. Bin storage details: new residential units or any new commercial building. Sustainability statement and SDC checklist: any new building. Energy Statement: minor developments creating new residential or commercial units. Ventilation/extraction details with acoustic report: commercial extraction flues, and change of use to A3/A4/A5. Biodiversity Net Gain statement and statutory metric: statutory, for major and small sites. London Datahub (1APP) data: all applications. Design Charter response within the DAS (Policy DM1). Completed draft S106 using the council template: all new buildings that are not zero carbon, and car-free proposals.
issues.evidence: Accessibility statement: 'All applications that involve the creation of any new residential units'; Energy Statement: 'minor developments creating new residential and/or commercial units'; Sustainability statement: 'Any new buildings'; Completed draft S106: 'All development proposing a new building that is not zero carbon'

issues.detail: Many major and strategic requirements were not captured. Independent fire strategy: majors, under London Plan D11. Gateway 1 Fire Statement: relevant buildings of 18m or more, or 7 or more storeys. Water/wastewater utilities capacity letter: majors. Drainage/SuDS plan and Haringey pro-formas: majors, and new residential units in Critical Drainage Areas. Landscape report with Urban Greening Factor: majors. Be Seen energy template: majors. Overheating assessment (TM59/TM52): majors. Air quality assessment: majors, since the whole borough is an AQMA. Dust and emissions assessment with NRMM: majors. Sunlight/daylight assessment: major new build and tall buildings. Circular Economy Statement and Whole Life Carbon Assessment: applications referable to the Mayor. Viability assessment with a redacted copy: more than 10 units or 1,000 sqm where affordable housing is below 35% (50% on industrial or public land). Waste Management Plan: majors and larger HMOs. Retail assessment: retail over 2,500 sqm. BREEAM pre-assessment: non-residential schemes. Geo-located 3D massing model (FBX): 25 or more residential units or 2,500 sqm of commercial floorspace. This last one appears only as a merged fragment in tab_items.
issues.evidence: Drainage: 'All major developments'; Air quality assessment: 'All applications for major development', Geographic Location 'Air Quality Management Areas (AQMA)'

issues.detail: Grokbot set several application types to (none) or left them incomplete even though the source has specific items for them. Listed building consent is missing 1:20 architectural details (doors, windows, shopfronts, railings) and the structural/historic building survey. Advertisement consent is missing the lighting scheme and prior GLA/TfL consultation for adverts affecting the TLRN. Outline is missing height/width/length parameter plans with upper and lower limits. Reserved matters and discharge of conditions are missing the statement identifying the outline permission and conditions. Works to trees is missing the AIA, which the source requires for tree works to TPO or Conservation Area trees. Telecoms prior approvals are missing the supporting statement with an ICNIRP certificate. The Sport England checklist for playing-field land is also missing.
issues.evidence: Source items: 'Architectural details (1:20)' for Listed building consent; 'Outline application height/width/length plans'; 'Telecommunications supporting statement and ICNIRP certificate'

issues.detail: A tab_item merges two separate requirements. The text 'Geo-located 3D Massing Model ... Basement Impact Assessment ... Development of 25 residential units or 2,500sqm' attaches the 3D-model threshold to the Basement Impact Assessment. The BIA actually applies to any new basement, whatever the scale.
issues.evidence: BIA: 'All applications proposing, new basement development'; 3D model: 'Development of 25 residential units or 2,500sqm of commercial floorspace or more'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are boilerplate or fragments, not requirements. 'Validation dispute ... Local planning authorities should only request supporting information that is reasonable' is generic national text. 'Applicants will need to provide reasons for any information to be redacted' is a stray fragment of the viability item. 'Local Plan Policy DM21 ... ngeygovuk/files/haringeys_summary_k ey_overheating...' is a garbled URL fragment that loses the sustainability statement trigger ('Any new buildings').

The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row under Full planning is not a validation requirement. Its excerpt is a garbled pre-app URL followed by the S106 template sentence. The source recommends pre-application advice but does not require evidence of it for validation.
issues.evidence: Excerpt: 'httgs:// -and-buildingcontrol/glanning/... A template S106 will be provided on the Council's website'

issues.detail: The trigger for Noise Impact Assessment is wrong. It joins the ventilation item's 'Acoustic report to be included' to the archaeology desk-based assessment text. The source triggers a noise assessment when a proposal will change the acoustic environment, for example noise-generating uses near housing, or housing near major roads, rail or industry.
issues.evidence: Noise impact assessment: 'When proposal will result in a change to the qualitative or quantitative acoustic environment'

issues.detail: The Energy / Sustainability Statement trigger covers majors only and quotes 'Part L 2013'. The source also requires an Energy Statement from minor developments that create new residential or commercial units, and a separate sustainability statement for any new building.
issues.evidence: Energy Statement: 'Majors' and 'minor developments creating new residential and/or commercial units'

issues.detail: The trigger for Planning Obligations / S106 draft Heads of Terms is only 'A template S106 will be provided on the Council's website'. The source asks for draft heads of terms on major developments (recommended rather than mandatory). It requires a completed draft S106 for any new building that is not zero carbon and for car-free proposals.
issues.evidence: S106 draft heads of terms: major developments; Completed draft S106: 'All development proposing a new building that is not zero carbon'

issues.detail: The Archaeological Assessment trigger leaves out the location condition. The source requires it only where development may affect archaeology within or adjacent to Areas of Archaeological Potential or Priority Areas, with GLAAS consultation.
issues.evidence: 'All applications that may have an impact on archaeology within or adjacent to Areas of Archaeological Potential'

issues.detail: Several other triggers are garbled or cut off. Transport Assessment gives only the 1,000 sqm retail/B1 threshold and omits the other uses, places of worship and sensitive TLRN, rail and Underground locations. The Travel Plan excerpt begins with an email address and stops mid-table. Crime prevention runs straight into the Statement of Community Involvement text. Tall buildings/wind runs into the sunlight/daylight text and omits the 6-storey or 18m definition.
issues.evidence: Travel Plan excerpt: 'information on travel plans contact transport.planning@haringey.gov.uk Where a development...'

issues.detail: 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' duplicates the 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' row, with the same excerpt. Haringey has no biodiversity questionnaire. The source item is a 'Biodiversity survey and report'.
issues.evidence: Both rows quote 'Biodiversity survey and report Including- Preliminary Ecological Appraisal...'

issues.detail: Grokbot marks most rows 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' even though the source has a 'Types of Application' column that states applicability. Block plan, floor plans and elevations, biodiversity survey and site photographs are marked 'All' (all applications) but appear only under Full planning. Affordable housing applies only to more than 10 net units, and crime prevention, SCI and the S106 heads of terms to majors, yet they sit under Full planning without that qualifier.
issues.evidence: Block Plan row: 'Types of Application ... All applications'

issues.detail: Contaminated Land and 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' are placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)'. The source has no minerals or waste application category. The waste excerpt 'design of waste management facilities' is a fragment, and the source's real waste items are bin storage details for new residential and commercial buildings and a Waste Management Plan for majors and larger HMOs.

The Flood Risk Assessment row is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source's words 'change of use' refer to planning applications for new development. The local list does not cover prior approval applications.
issues.evidence: 'all proposals for new development (including minor development and change of use) in Flood Zones 2 and 3'

summary: Grokbot links the current Haringey list (August 2024, effective 29 Aug 2024), though a draft 2026 replacement has been consulted on. Its extraction captures only about 20 of roughly 60 items. It puts the one householder-excluded item (contaminated land) under Householder, misses most energy, fire, drainage, basement, accessibility and major-scheme requirements, and has many garbled triggers.
